info.cls_ename: Department of Aerospace and Systems Engineering

description.describe_ch: 「飛航管制學」主要目的係遵照國際民航組織規定及本國飛航及管制辦法，協議書或民航局或軍方文件另有其他程序或最低標準之規定，為防止航空器間發生碰撞，安排及加速航行流量，此外並提供有限度之附加服務。說明其附加服務之規範與能力受到航行量、無線電擁擠、雷達品質、管制員工作量、較高優先事宜或超出體能限制等因素影響。
description.describe_eh: The primary purpose of the ATC（Air Triffic Controlled） to conform with ICAO（International Civil Aviation Organization） Documents, and ROC（Republic of china） Flight Regulations,Other proceures or minima are prescribed in a LOA（Letter Of Agreement ）,a CAA（Civil Aeronautics Administration） directive or a military documents, to prevent a collision between aircraft operating in the system and to organize and expedite the flow of traffic.In addition to its primary function,the ATC system has the capability to provide with certain limitations additional services.The ability to provide additional services is limited by many factors,such as the volume of traffic,frequency congestion ,quality of radar,controller workload,higher priority duties,and the pure physical inability to scan and detect those situations that fall in this category.
